name: Alba
self_text: Hi! I'm Alba, a Brazilian non-binary person in my late 30s. When I'm not focusing on photography, I spend a lot of my time collecting vinyl, as I love the tactile feel of music. I use a Canon camera and I'm looking for a structured instruction session to improve my skills. I prefer a fast pace and would really enjoy having plenty of gear talk during our time together. Regarding the technical side, I'm looking for someone to teach me post-processing. In terms of the shoot, I am fine with not taking portraits of each other. I'm currently free on Saturday mornings to make this happen. I'm excited to dive into the technicalities and get some high-energy practice in!

requests.request_text: I need you to be the one who teaches me post-processing, and you have to be okay with a moderate pace or a slow pace. It's a deal-breaker unless you are okay with not taking portraits of each other. Ideally, you are okay with gear talk being fine but not the point or plenty of gear talk, but no big deal.
